all_candidates.title: Universal directional recovery
all_candidates.description: Extend directional probability recovery to all non-blocked regimes with actionable engine signal.

all_candidates.title: Regime strength floor on actionable signals
all_candidates.description: Floor regime_strength at 0.65 when engine emits BUY/SELL to prevent over-compression before policy gate.

all_candidates.title: Engine-confidence policy gate
all_candidates.description: DecisionPolicy passes if max(composite_conf, model_confidence) >= threshold — avoids double compression rejection.

all_candidates.title: Alternate engine confirmation
all_candidates.description: When primary engine HOLDs, promote alternate engine if directional probability >= 0.55.

all_candidates.title: Spread-aware market quality
all_candidates.description: Skip market_quality compression when spread < 4 pips (uses existing spread tiers from ConfidenceEngine).
